description: Scenarios for checking that an agent using the expoemu skill tests Expo apps correctly. Run each prompt in an Expo project on a Mac with expoemu set up, and compare the agent's behaviour with expected_behavior.

evals.prompt: Run my app on Android and show me what the home screen looks like.
expected_behavior: Runs `expoemu status` first and `expoemu up` only if something is down
Takes `expoemu screenshot` and reads the printed PNG path
Describes the screen from the screenshot, not from guesses

evals.prompt: I changed the login button text to 'Continue with email'. Check it shows up on Android.
expected_behavior: Uses `expoemu wait-for "Continue with email"` (or assert-text) instead of assuming
If not found, checks `expoemu expo --logs` / `logcat --errors` or reopens with `expoemu open`
Reports pass/fail with evidence (screenshot or command output)

evals.prompt: Test the sign-in flow with ada@example.com / wrongpass and tell me what error the user sees.
expected_behavior: Uses `fill` with the field's text, placeholder or testID for both fields
Taps the sign-in control with `tap-text`
Waits for the error with `wait-for` and reports the exact message, with a screenshot

evals.prompt: The app shows a red error screen after my last change. Find out why.
expected_behavior: Collects `expoemu logcat` (ReactNativeJS stack) and/or `expoemu expo --logs`
Points to the failing file/line from the stack and proposes or applies a fix
Verifies the fix with `reload`/`open` plus `wait-for` or a screenshot

evals.prompt: What does my app do when the phone is offline?
expected_behavior: Uses `expoemu network off`, exercises the app, captures what is shown
Restores with `expoemu network on` afterwards
Does not stop Metro or the emulator to simulate offline

evals.prompt: Check that the settings screen looks right on a tablet and on a phone.
expected_behavior: Creates a tablet device if `expoemu devices` lists none (`device create … --profile tablet`)
Starts it with `emulator start --device …`, opens the app on both (`open --all`)
Navigates on each device with `--device` and compares `screenshot --all` output

evals.prompt: Add the zod package to my project.
expected_behavior: Installs it with the project's own package manager on the host as usual, and in the container via `expoemu shell <pm> install zod` so the running app sees it
Does not use a global adb or install Android tools on the Mac

evals.prompt: Clean everything up, I'm done for today.
expected_behavior: Runs `expoemu down` (keeps image, caches and devices)
Does NOT run `cleanup` or delete devices without asking

evals.prompt: Test that fingerprint login works and that a wrong finger shows an error.
expected_behavior: Runs `expoemu biometric status` and `expoemu biometric enroll` only if no fingerprint is enrolled
Triggers the app prompt, then uses `expoemu biometric fail` and checks the error with `wait-for`
Uses `expoemu biometric touch` and verifies success; offers `expoemu biometric reset` afterwards

evals.prompt: How does the feed screen behave on a slow 2G/3G connection?
expected_behavior: Uses `expoemu network edge` (or gprs/3g), not `network off`
Captures loading states with screenshots and waits with generous timeouts
Restores with `expoemu network full` afterwards
